title: Shadow of the Storm
start: Speak to Father Reen just south of Al Kharid bank.

items.t: Silverlight (If you do not have the sword, it can be re-obtained during the quest)
Empty vial (To dye Silverlight/clothing black if you have not done so already)
3 pieces of a black outfit (see Blending into the dark; you can also dye the desert robe and desert shirt during the quest for two of the pieces)
The strange implement (If lost, it can be re-obtained during the quest)

recommended.t: Waterskins (approximately 5 full waterskins) or an enchanted water tiara.
Food and potions for lower levelled players
A charged amulet of glory, ring of duelling, a broomstick for teleporting to Al Kharid or an activated Al Kharid lodestone could be useful
A traveller's necklace for faster travel to Uzer

rewards.t: 10000 Combat XP, as a combat XP lamp, in one of: scl | Attack , scl | Strength , scl | Defence , scl | Constitution , scl | Ranged , scl | Magic or scl | Necromancy
rewards.l: Combat XP lamp (Shadow of the Storm)

rewards.t: Demonic sigil (can be used to chant any number of times even after the quest)

Silverlight turns into Darklight: It is even more powerful against demons. If a player loses Darklight, it can be retrieved by talking to Gideon Bede at Varrock's north church. You must have him replace Silverlight for you first.

steps.t: Talk to Father Reen south of Al Kharid bank. [Chat: Accept]

sub.t: He will give you Silverlight if you've dyed or destroyed it.

steps.t: Talk to Father Badden at Uzer, east of Shantay Pass. (Optional: take the magic carpet to Uzer) [Chat: 1 Reen sent me. › 3 So what do you want me to do? › 1 How can I do that?]

Pick and grind a black mushroom (the closest is just south-east of the stairs east of Father Badden). Use it to dye Silverlight black. You can find some beside the staircase, downstairs east of the stairwell, or in the north east corner of the room, east of Evil Dave.
Go down the stairs.

sub.t: If you do not have the strange implement from The Golem quest, you can pick it up from the ground in the northwest room.

steps.t: Talk to Evil Dave wearing your three black items and your dyed Silverlight. He is standing at the entrance to Agrith Naar's demonic temple in the underground Uzer ruins. [Chat: 2 I want to join your group. › 1 I'm evil!]
p: Evil Dave requires that you wear an 'evil' outfit before he lets you through the portal.
Denath and Dave welcome you to the order.

steps.t: Talk to Denath. [Chat: 4 What do I have to do?]
Talk to Jennifer to get a demonic sigil mould. [Chat: 2 Do you have the demonic sigil mould?]
Talk to Matthew. [Chat: 3 Do you know what happened to Josef?]
Go to any furnace and smelt a demonic sigil. [Chat: 1 Make Demonic sigil]

sub.t: Your black outfit can be discarded at this point and replaced with combat gear. Keep Silverlight for the duration of the quest.

steps.t: Talk to the clay golem outside the ruins about last night. [Chat: 3 Did you see anything happen last night?]

Look in the nearby Broken kilns for a book until you have found the Demonic tome (there's a broken kiln north of the Rug Merchant and one behind the walls east of the staircase that are easy to miss).
Talk to Matthew back in the lair.
Go north to talk to Denath and write down the incantation he tells you. [Chat: 4]
Complete the circle and click the sigil to chant the incantation. Be sure to remember it, as you’ll need it again later in the quest.
p: Denath steps into the circle and returns to his home plane.

steps.t: Be sure to take the sigil from the floor, or you will have to make a new one at a furnace.
Enter the portal and take Tanya's sigil.
Tell Evil Dave to return to the lair - you should have 4 sigils now. [Chat: 2 You've got to get back to the throne room!]
Go up the stairs, talk to Father Badden and Father Reen. [Chat: 3 Oh, don't be so simple-minded!]
Talk to the golem. [Chat: 4 [use strange implement]]
Return to the throne room downstairs.
Talk to Matthew to start the incantation. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Form the circle and Chant demonic sigil and say the incantation in reverse. (If you have forgotten the incantation, it can be found on page 6 of the demonic tome.)
Kill the demon with the Silverlight (dyed). After defeating it, you will have the Darklight equipped.

sub.t: You can damage the demon with any combat style, but you must equip the Silverlight (dyed) as it dies.

p: Agrith Naar is summoned, and kills Matthew
Agrith Naar's blood stains Silverlight, turning it into Darklight.

steps.t: Quest complete!
